 Lumbini Lions beat Janakpur Bolts by 16 runs to remain unbeaten in NPL 
 Nepal News 
 November 5, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: The Defending champions Lumbini Lions defeated inaugural champions Janakpur Bolts by 16 runs on Thursday to maintain their unbeaten run in the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 Chasing a target of 150, Janakpur managed 133-8 in 20 overs. Captain Harmit Singh top-scored with 33 off 20 balls, including three sixes, while Aditya Mahata remained unbeaten on 30 off 23 balls. Saif Hassan added 28 and opener Trit Raj Das scored 18.
 Lumbini’s D’Arcy Short took three wickets for 23 runs in four overs, while Tilak Bhandari claimed two wickets.
 Earlier, Lumbini posted 149-8 in 20 overs after being put in to bat. Captain Rohit Paudel top-scored with 38 off 31 balls, while Niroshan Dickwella made 27. Aasif Sheikh and Dilip Nath contributed 21 runs each.
 The victory takes Lumbini to seven points from four matches, keeping them at the top of the standings. Janakpur, meanwhile, suffered their third defeat in five matches and must win their remaining two games to stay in contention for the playoffs.
